propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the evaluation harness and the labelled adviser-review set, adding 1,200 newly labelled alerts over the year.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the harness and the labelled set directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran pre-release evaluations for four model versions and published the evaluation reports.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the evaluation work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The adviser false-alert rate fell from 31 percent in Q1 to 18 percent in Q4 after the threshold recalibration adopted in version 3.2, against a documented baseline of 31 percent.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the rates, the period, the baseline and the measurement set; the work sample and reference confirm them.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each model version are only partly documented in the evaluation notes.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the false-alert result as stated for the labelled review set and the year; do not extend it to alert precision in general.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how hand-over items were recorded between evaluations.
